title: [Audit] Cross-space Kibana activity
description: Which identities work in which Kibana spaces, all Kibana traffic, one row per identity. Identities in more than one space are the ones worth understanding. Spaces appear by id (the /s/<id> in the URL).
esql: SET unmapped_fields="nullify"; FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE kibana.space.id IS NOT NULL | EVAL actor = COALESCE(user.email, api_key.name, user.name, "<anonymous>") | STATS events = COUNT(*), spaces = COUNT_DISTINCT(kibana.space.id), space_list = VALUES(kibana.space.id) BY actor | SORT spaces DESC, events DESC | EVAL space_list = REPLACE(MV_CONCAT(MV_SORT(space_list), ", "), "-", "-⁠") | EVAL actor = CASE((LENGTH(actor) == 20 AND actor RLIKE "[-_A-Za-z0-9]{20}" AND NOT actor RLIKE "[0-9]{20}"), CONCAT(LEFT(actor, 5), "… · Cloud API key"), actor) | RENAME actor AS Identity, spaces AS Spaces, space_list AS `Space list`, events AS Events
